body:
Define and enforce the promotion gate before making the Rust integration the default runtime.

Acceptance criteria:
- Require coverage of necessary symbols and regressions without unadjudicated differences.
- Require performance overhead within the agreed limit.
- Verify native/LibFuzzer flows and the KLEE decision.
- Require current documentation and a versioned release.
- Defer promotion to default if any gate remains incomplete.

Related work: Add differential tests against the C implementation; Measure and control performance regressions; Run the KLEE feasibility gate and record the decision; Document compatibility deviations and release process; Integrate Rust into Map2Check CMake behind an opt-in option.
title: Apply readiness criteria before promoting the Rust integration

body:
After a successful regression period, migrate consumers to the core Rust API and JSON output, then remove legacy compatibility only when no consumers remain.

Acceptance criteria:
- Require a regression cycle with no unadjudicated differences before migration.
- Migrate passes to the core API and frontend to the supported JSON schema.
- Remove the compatibility layer and embedded C runtime only after confirming no orphaned symbols or consumers.
- Keep a rollback option to the legacy runtime during the transition.

Repository scope: Pass and frontend migration work occurs in `hbgit/Map2Check`; the library-side compatibility removal occurs here.
Related work: Add a compatibility layer for current Map2Check passes; Integrate Rust into Map2Check CMake behind an opt-in option; Add differential tests against the C implementation.
title: Migrate consumers and retire compatibility only after parity

body:
In the external `hbgit/Map2Check` repository, add an initially disabled CMake option for selecting the Rust runtime.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add `MAP2CHECK_RUST_RUNTIME`, disabled by default, and compile/link `libmap2check.a` for native workflows when enabled.
- Apply the recorded KLEE feasibility decision to KLEE workflows.
- Prevent simultaneous linking of C and Rust runtimes when they would produce duplicate symbols.
- Test the option with a small regression program.

Dependency: Run the KLEE feasibility gate and record the decision; Add a compatibility layer for current Map2Check passes.
Repository scope: This issue lives in `hbgit/map2check-library` but implementation changes belong in `hbgit/Map2Check`.
title: Integrate Rust into Map2Check CMake behind an opt-in option

body:
Add an isolated compatibility feature in this repository for symbols/signatures used by passes in `hbgit/Map2Check@develop`, delegating to the Rust core API.

Acceptance criteria:
- Build the complete symbol/signature matrix required by current passes.
- Resolve and document the `map2check_check_deref` signature collision.
- Explicitly exclude wasm symbols if they remain out of scope.
- Add compatibility tests for the selected feature.

Repository scope: This issue is tracked in `hbgit/map2check-library`; required pass API evidence comes from `hbgit/Map2Check`.
Related work: Align the C ABI with the Rust library; Implement the legacy result-channel compatibility; Integrate Rust into Map2Check CMake behind an opt-in option.
title: Add a compatibility layer for current Map2Check passes

body:
Prototype and assess a Rust implementation of the KLEE integration before choosing whether the Rust runtime can support that flow.

Acceptance criteria:
- Prototype `klee` nondeterminism using `klee_make_symbolic`, symbolic-compatible state, and bitcode emission/linking.
- Test the reference KLEE program with a compatible LLVM version.
- Record evidence, limitations, and a go/no-go decision in `docs/klee-feasibility.md`.
- If Rust is not viable, formalize the C-library fallback for KLEE.

Related work: Validate C, KLEE, and LibFuzzer build and test flows; Integrate Rust into Map2Check CMake behind an opt-in option.
title: Run the KLEE feasibility gate and record the decision

body:
In addition to JSON, emit the sentinel files consumed by the current Map2Check result parser.

Acceptance criteria:
- Implement `map2check_property_*` files with the names and formats expected by the current parser.
- Add golden tests for sentinel files and JSON.
- Validate property, line, and function fields against outputs from the embedded C library.

Repository scope: The ticket is tracked here, but consumer/parser compatibility must be checked against `hbgit/Map2Check`.
Related work: Add a compatibility layer for current passes; Maintain JSON compatibility with the existing consumer.
title: Implement the legacy result-channel compatibility

body:
Establish reproducible performance measurements against the C implementation and define regression handling.

Acceptance criteria:
- Create reproducible benchmarks using reference programs and a fixed LibFuzzer corpus.
- Record measurements and profiles when overhead exceeds 10%.
- Add periodic CI execution.
- Define and check the maximum acceptable median regression as 10%.
title: Measure and control performance regressions

body:
Make the supported C/KLEE/LibFuzzer integration paths explicit and verifiable for the Rust library.

Acceptance criteria:
- Decide and document whether KLEE has Rust support or requires a C fallback.
- Make expected build artifacts mandatory and fail builds when they are absent.
- Add C link/run tests to CI for supported flows.
- Update scripts and documentation to reflect the current Rust layout rather than assuming the legacy `build/` layout.

Related work: Correct and enforce strict release and CI builds; Run the KLEE feasibility gate and record the decision; Cover the C API with integration programs.
title: Validate C, KLEE, and LibFuzzer build and test flows

body:
Make release and CI build steps match the current Rust project layout and fail when required artifacts are missing.

Acceptance criteria:
- Correct Dockerfile paths/stages for the current Rust sources and tests.
- Align Rust versions in Dockerfile, `rust-toolchain.toml`, and README.
- Validate header generation, lint, formatting, dependency audit, and coverage in CI.
- Remove obsolete build artifacts only when confirmed unused.
- Do not mask bitcode generation or linking failures with `|| true`.

Related work: Validate C/KLEE/LibFuzzer build and test flows; Integrate Rust into Map2Check CMake behind an opt-in option.
title: Correct and enforce strict release and CI builds

body:
Add end-to-end comparisons between the legacy C implementation and the Rust implementation for fixed reference programs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Compare ABI/symbols, verdict, property, source line, and JSON schema.
- Classify intentional differences and retain reproducible regression cases in CI.
- Ensure comparisons cover more than the existing Rust unit tests and exercise representative C programs.

Related work: Align the C ABI with the Rust library; Maintain JSON compatibility with the existing consumer; Cover the C API with integration programs.
title: Add differential tests against the C implementation

body:
Define and test the supported JSON schema across the existing C consumer and the Rust implementation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Reconcile container names (`container_trackbb_log`, `container_nondet_log`, `container_memtrack_log` versus the Rust names).
- Reconcile record fields including `var_mem_address`/`mem_address_points_to` versus `var_addr`/`points_to`, and nondet `type`/`value` representation.
- Decide whether top-level `function_name` is part of the supported schema.
- Add compatibility snapshots/tests for serialized records and report shape. JSON whitespace differences alone need not be treated as semantic incompatibilities.

Related work: Add differential tests against the C implementation; Document compatibility deviations and release process.
title: Maintain JSON compatibility with the existing consumer

body:
Reconcile the exported Rust ABI with the C API that existed in the prior implementation, preserving compatibility or documenting deliberate contract changes.

Acceptance criteria:
- Export or explicitly justify removal of `get_next_step`, `map2check_map_non_static_alloca`, `map2check_map_funct_address`, and `map2check_check_free_resolved_address`.
- Align `map2check_save_nondet_log_*` parameter and return contracts with the chosen supported C API, or document intentional changes.
- Regenerate and verify `include/map2check.h` from the effective Rust ABI.
- Add symbol/signature checks and appropriate C link coverage.

Related work: Complete or explicitly deprecate remaining nondet symbols; Cover the C API with integration programs; Document compatibility deviations and release process.
title: Align the C ABI with the Rust library

body:
Resolve the API mismatch between the Rust nondeterministic generators and the C library symbols consumed by LibFuzzer integrations.

Acceptance criteria:
- Implement symbols still consumed, or migrate and document consumers against the replacement API.
- Verify exported symbols and link and execute a C program against the Rust library.
- Include the disposition of `map2check_gen_data_fuzzer_*` and `map2check_fuzzer_assume`.

Related work: Complete or explicitly deprecate remaining nondet symbols; Align the C ABI with the Rust library.
title: Restore or explicitly replace the LibFuzzer generation API

body:
Correct allocation-history checks so a freed allocation is not still considered valid due to an older allocation record.

Acceptance criteria:
- Determine validity using the latest applicable allocation/free event.
- Add tests for use-after-free, reallocation, and allocation range boundaries.
- Preserve valid access behavior for live allocations and reject accesses outside their ranges.
title: Fix address validation after free

body:
Implement the configured memory-cleanup and null-pointer policies in the Rust runtime.

Acceptance criteria:
- Store and apply the options set by `map2check_set_memcleanup()` and `map2check_set_null_is_valid()` rather than leaving them as no-op stubs.
- Pass the configured null policy through `map2check_check_load()`.
- Preserve the expected `map2check_check_mem_endprog()` behavior with and without cleanup verification.
- Add focused tests for both settings and end-of-program behavior.
title: Implement memory-safety option semantics

body:
Make repeated initialization and fuzz iterations independent rather than retaining global analysis state from a prior run.

Acceptance criteria:
- Reset state at the appropriate lifecycle boundaries.
- Add tests for two consecutive initializations and two consecutive LibFuzzer iterations.
- Verify counters, containers, and output results from the second run do not include first-run data.

Related work: Review `map2check_init()`, `AnalysisState`, and the LibFuzzer callback lifecycle.
title: Reset analysis state between analyses and fuzzing iterations

body:
Define and enforce failure behavior for Rust exports at the `extern "C"` boundary.

Acceptance criteria:
- Define behavior for panic-capable and `panic = "abort"` build profiles; prevent unwinding across FFI where recovery is possible and document when it is not.
- Add a C harness for exports called before initialization and valid boundary inputs.
- Run the harness with ASan/UBSan where supported.
- Do not use arbitrary invalid pointers as test inputs because dereferencing them can cause undefined behavior before Rust validation.
title: Prevent unhandled failures from crossing the FFI boundary

body:
Build and execute representative C clients against the Rust-generated library to validate actual ABI integration.

Acceptance criteria:
- Compile, link, and run `test/codeAPI_by_caller_test.c`, `test/codefuzz_by_caller_test.c`, and `test/codeklee_by_caller_test.c` against the generated library.
- Preserve these integration cases in CI in addition to Rust unit tests.
- Report failures explicitly and ensure expected artifacts and symbols are present.

Related work: Align the C ABI with the Rust library; Complete or explicitly deprecate remaining nondet symbols; Correct and enforce strict release/CI builds.
title: Cover the C API with integration programs

body:
Resolve the remaining nondeterminism-related C symbols and record which are implemented versus intentionally deprecated or removed.

Acceptance criteria:
- Decide and document the contract for `__VERIFIER_nondet_pointer`, `__VERIFIER_assume`, `__VERIFIER_assert`, `__VERIFIER_error`, `map2check_fuzzer_assume`, and the `pchar`, `loff_t`, and `sector_t` generators.
- Implement symbols that have consumers; document removals for the rest.
- Verify C signatures and representations and add link/runtime coverage.

Related work: Restore or explicitly replace the LibFuzzer generation API; Align the C ABI with the Rust library.
title: Complete or explicitly deprecate remaining nondet symbols

body:
Document the Rust librarys intentional API and behavior deviations from the C implementation, and define how compatibility artifacts are delivered with a release.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add and maintain `docs/api-deltas.md` with a symbol/signature compatibility matrix.
- Add and maintain `docs/semantic-deltas.md` with reproducible cases for intentional behavior differences.
- Update the changelog and document release packaging for the C header and integration guide.
- Ensure the documents reflect decisions made in the ABI, JSON, and integration issues.

Related work: Align the C ABI with the Rust library; Maintain JSON compatibility with the existing consumer; Add a compatibility layer for current passes.
title: Document compatibility deviations and release process
